/bin/bash -lc "python3 pilot-c01-c02/scripts/coach.py pause --learner synthetic-agent; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,datetime,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import validate_personal_roadmap as v
p=Path('pilot-c01-c02/records/synthetic-agent/sigma');s=json.loads((p/'state.json').read_text())
s.update(status='paused',pause_raw_response='我累了，不想继续。',action='立即暂停，不再提问；保留当前未答问题',reason='学习者明确表示疲劳并拒绝继续；不计错误或低分。',route_version=4)
(p/'state.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
with (p/'turns.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),**s},ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
with (p/'session.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\\n## 暂停\\n学习者原话：“我累了，不想继续。”\\n\\n立即暂停，无新增作答、评分或正式证据。保留未答问题：“'+s['question']+'”\\n\\n正式训练卡先前已完成；Sigma 开放探究暂停。恢复须重新 survey、检查发布/先修及路线状态，再恢复此未答问题。家长观察 unknown；不推断稳定能力或心理标签。路线版本4，以存储返回为准。\\n')
ctx=v.context('synthetic-agent');plan=json.loads((p/'personal-roadmap.json').read_text())
for k in ['curriculum_digest','evidence_digest','learner_digest']:plan[k]=ctx[k]
plan['steps'][0]['reason']='学习者明确疲劳，当前暂停。恢复先重验资料、门禁及路线，并恢复未答动态问题；既有一次正式证据不构成掌握。'
(p/'personal-roadmap.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
PY
python3 scripts/sigma_plan_store.py publish --learner synthetic-agent --plan pilot-c01-c02/records/synthetic-agent/sigma/personal-roadmap.json"
